name: epic-shepherd
description: Shepherd a whole GitHub Epic (issue with sub-issues) to completion. Phase 1 (extract-sequence) snapshots open sub-issue topology + blocked_by edges into a tier-ordered sequence. Phase 2 (tick loop, /loop /epic-shepherd:shepherd) is the autonomous driver — dispatches an implementer (rfc-loop / autopilot / inline) for each ready issue, polls for the opened PR, hands off to pr-shepherd to drain reviews + merge, then regenerates the snapshot so closed issues advance the frontier. Hard stops (human CHANGES_REQUESTED, branch protection, conflict, ping-pong cap, implementer failure) pause the loop and surface the reason. Phase 3 (close-out report + gh issue close) on the roadmap for v0.3.
